title: (RHEA-2015:1069) maven30 bug fix and enhancement update
portal_summary:
Updated maven30 packages that fix several bugs and add various enhancements are
now available as part of Red Hat Software Collections 2.0 for Red Hat Enterprise
Linux.

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant
to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The maven30 Software Collection provides a software project management and
comprehension tool. Based on the concept of a project object model (POM), Maven
can manage a project's build, reporting, and documentation from a central piece
of information. 

The maven30 packages have been updated to a later version that is required by
Red Hat Software Collections 2.0. The maven30 Collection now requires the
rh-java-common Software Collection. (BZ#1170614)

Users of maven30 are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix
these bugs and add these enhancements.
